booklet.name: Create Booklet
booklet.short: Impose pages for a folded booklet.

steps: Choose the sheet size (A4, Letter, A3).
Download, print double-sided (flip on short edge), fold in the middle.

Download the PDF with twice the pages.

faq.q: Is the content cropped or rasterized?
faq.a: Neither – each half is the original vector page with a new visible area.

overlay.name: Overlay PDF
overlay.short: Put letterhead or a stamp on every page.

steps: Select your document and then the overlay PDF.
Choose on top or underneath and how overlay pages repeat.

faq.q: Can I use one letterhead page for all pages?
faq.a: Yes – choose 'First page only on all pages'.

pagesize.name: Change Page Size
pagesize.short: Resize PDF pages to A4, Letter and more.
pagesize.title: Change PDF Page Size – Resize PDF to A4 or Letter Online | {brand}
pagesize.desc: Convert PDF page size to A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5 and more. Content is scaled to fit and centered, staying sharp vector.
steps: Pick the new page size, orientation and margin.

resizepdf.name: Resize PDF
resizepdf.short: Scale PDF pages to a new paper size.
resizepdf.title: Resize PDF – Scale Pages to A4, Letter, A3 Free | {brand}
resizepdf.desc: Resize PDF pages to any standard paper size online. Mixed page sizes become uniform. Free, no upload.

faq.q: Is this the same as compressing?
faq.a: No – this changes the paper size. To reduce file size use Compress PDF.

rasterize.name: Rasterize PDF
rasterize.title: Rasterize PDF – Convert PDF Pages to Images Inside a PDF | {brand}
rasterize.desc: Flatten every page into an image: fixes printing problems, hides selectable text and layers. Choose DPI, JPG or lossless PNG.

faq.a: To flatten complex files that print wrong, or to stop easy copying of text.

webopt.name: Optimize PDF for Web
webopt.short: Lighter PDFs that load faster online.
webopt.title: Optimize PDF for Web – Smaller, Faster PDF Online Free | {brand}
webopt.desc: Rebuild a PDF for the web: compact object streams, remove unused objects, thumbnails and scripts. Private, in your browser.

faq.a: Not in the browser. Modern viewers stream PDFs fine; for strongest size reduction also try Compress PDF.

removemeta.name: Remove PDF Metadata
removemeta.short: Strip author, title and hidden data.
removemeta.title: Remove PDF Metadata – Delete Author & Hidden Info Free | {brand}
removemeta.desc: Remove author, creator, dates, XMP and other hidden metadata from PDFs before sharing. Optionally remove attachments and scripts.

faq.a: The document info (title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, dates), XMP metadata and page piece data.

passgen.name: Password Generator
passgen.short: Strong random passwords, made on your device.
passgen.title: Password Generator – Strong Random Passwords Free | {brand}
passgen.desc: Generate strong random passwords with your choice of length and characters. Uses your device's secure random generator; nothing is sent anywhere.

faq.a: They are created with the browser's cryptographic random generator and never leave your device.

faq.q: How long should a password be?
faq.a: At least 16 characters with all character types (~100 bits) is very strong.

searchpdf.name: Search in PDFs
searchpdf.title: Search in PDF Files – Find Text in Multiple PDFs Online | {brand}
searchpdf.desc: Search for a word or phrase across many PDF files at once. See every match with page number and context, and export to CSV.
steps: See matches with page numbers; download CSV.

faq.a: Only PDFs with a text layer. Run OCR PDF first for scans.

steps: Press Use camera and snap each page (or pick photos).

faq.a: Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Indic, Arabic, Hebrew and Thai scripts are embedded with Noto fonts. CJK is not yet supported.

faq.a: Use OCR PDF first to recognize the text.
